# M2 feature outputs

Generated by `python -m src.features` (Member 2).

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `customer_features.parquet` | Modelling feature table (includes unchanged M1 `churn`) |
| `customer_features.csv` | Same (CSV) |
| `feature_summary.csv` | Numeric describe() summary |
| `m2_validation_report.json` | M1 handoff checks, feature validation, outliers, figure list |
| `figures/` | EDA plots |

**Do not edit by hand.** Re-run the pipeline to regenerate.  
Member 3 should start from `customer_features.parquet` + `docs/feature_dictionary.md`.
